_doc: fc-single-014 (time): list_calendar over the explicit UTC day range 2026-11-04T00:00:00Z -> 2026-11-05T00:00:00Z. Decoys are schedule_meeting, get_current_time and cancel_meeting. Tests turning 'the 2026-11-04 (UTC day)' into a half-open from/to range.
prompt: List every meeting on my calendar for 2026-11-04 (UTC day). I want to see what's already booked that day.

function.name: schedule_meeting
function.description: Schedule a calendar meeting. `attendees` is a list of email addresses, `date` is YYYY-MM-DD, `time` is HH:MM in 24h, `timezone` is an IANA tz like 'Europe/London', `duration_minutes` is an integer.

function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Return the current local time in the given IANA timezone.

function.name: cancel_meeting
function.description: Cancel a previously scheduled meeting by its id.

function.name: list_calendar
function.description: List meetings scheduled between two ISO datetimes.
